question: I have recently graduated high school and am searching for a college or university to attend. Of the colleges and universities in Florida, which is closest to Tallahassee that satisfies the following criteria: was a National Merit college sponsor in the 2021 - 2022 academic year, and offers an undergraduate degree in aerospace engineering.

answer:
**University of Central Florida (UCF)**  

| Requirement | How UCF Meets It |
|-------------|-----------------|
| **National Merit College Sponsor (2021‑2022)** | UCF is listed as a sponsoring college in the National Merit Scholarship Program’s 2021‑2022 “Sponsors of National Merit® Scholarships” roster. |
| **Undergraduate degree in Aerospace Engineering** | UCF offers a full‑time **Bachelor of Science in Aerospace Engineering (B.S. AE)**, taught by the Department of Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering. |
| **Closest to Tallahassee** | Orlando, where UCF is located, is roughly 360–380 mi (about 5½–6 h by car or 0.6 h by flight) from Tallahassee, making it the nearest Florida institution that satisfies both criteria. |

**Why the other Florida college sponsors don’t fit**

| School | National Merit Sponsor? | Undergraduate Aerospace Engineering? |
|--------|------------------------|---------------------------------------|
| Florida State University (FSU) | Yes | No (only graduate‑level degree) |
| Florida International University (FIU) | Yes | No (only a minor) |
| Florida Atlantic University (FAU) | Yes | No (no full B.S. program) |

Thus, the **University of Central Florida** is the best match for your search criteria. If you’re ready to apply, you can find more details on UCF’s Aerospace Engineering program page or consider visiting the campus for an orientation. Good luck with your college plans!
